entries.45ffc890e8bdb352: This is a single-segment business that provides a reservation platform for comprehensive medical checkups and health examinations, and reservation systems for medical facilities, corporations and government bodies. The group consists of the company and 1 consolidated subsidiary (MRSO ASIA Co.,Ltd., Hanoi, Vietnam).
